First, I want to close my Green Account and just keep the Silver one going forward. The Green Account is empty — I already moved the money out. And second, I’ve also been meaning to open a savings account.

I can help with both of these — I can close your Green checking account and open a new personal savings account for you. Before I can act on or view your accounts I need to verify your identity (this is required for any account changes).

A couple of important notes before we proceed:
- The Green Account is a mid-tier checking account. If it’s being closed within 60 days of opening an early-closure fee of $25 may apply (it’s deducted from the account). I can check whether that fee applies after I verify you.
- If you open a savings account, Rho-Bank requires you to have at least one active checking account and that the checking account has been open at least 14 days. Because you plan to keep your Silver checking account, that should meet the requirement unless the Silver account is too new.
- Some checking + savings pairings give an APY boost. Green checking + Silver savings is a qualifying pairing; if you close Green you may lose any boost that pairing provides. Also, if you have multiple checking accounts that provide boosts, only the single highest boost is applied (they don’t stack).

To continue I need to verify your identity. Please provide any two of the following (pick two):
- Date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY)
- Email on file
- Phone number on file
- Current mailing address on file

After verification I will:
1) Confirm Green account status (open, zero balance, no pending transactions) and whether the early-closure fee applies, then close it if you confirm you want me to proceed.  
2) Check eligibility for opening a personal savings account. If eligible, I’ll ask which savings account_class you want (please give the exact name ending with "Account", e.g., "Silver Account" or "Gold Account") and whether you want me to transfer the opening deposit from your Silver checking now (if yes, tell me the amount to transfer). If you prefer to fund later, I’ll inform you of the 30-day funding window.

Which two identity items would you like to provide? Also tell me which savings account_class you’re interested in (if you don’t know, say so and I’ll list options).

Sure — here are two items for verification:

- Date of birth: 04/18/1990  
- Email: morgan.mitchell@gmail.com  

And on the savings account_class: I don’t know yet — I’d like your help picking the right one based on what I need.

Great — thanks for verifying. I can help pick the right savings account and proceed with the Green account closure once you confirm.

A few quick points relevant to your choices
- Green checking + Silver savings is a qualifying pairing for an APY boost. If you close Green before opening a savings account, you’ll lose that specific boost. If you keep Green (or reopen it later) you could get that boost with a Silver savings account. Also, when multiple checking accounts could boost a savings account, only the single highest boost applies (boosts don’t stack).
- I can check whether the Green account is subject to the $25 early‑closure fee and whether your Silver checking meets the 14‑day tenure requirement before making any changes. Would you like me to check those first?

Help picking a savings account (tell me which of these matters most and I’ll recommend one)
- Highest possible APY: choose one of the premium/elite savings classes (e.g., Diamond Elite Account, Platinum Plus Account, Platinum Account). These are positioned for higher yields.
- Low/no maintenance fees and easier access: choose mid-tier options (e.g., Silver Account or Bronze Account).
- Keep an APY boost tied to a checking account: choose Silver Account if you want the Green→Silver pairing boost (but closing Green removes that boost).
- Balanced option (good yield with moderate access/fees): consider Gold Account or Gold Plus Account.

What I need from you to proceed
1) Do you want me to check (a) whether the Green account has any early-closure fee applicable, and (b) whether your Silver checking meets the 14-day requirement — before we do anything? (recommended)  
2) Do you want to close the Green Account now? If yes, please provide the Green Account ID or the last 4 digits of the account number and confirm it has $0 balance and no pending transactions.
